findings.detection: task marked status=complete with an empty evidence payload while its own acceptance criteria require a named evidence file and before/after measurement
findings.detail: GAP-003 flips to "status":"complete" with detail.evidence only `{"run_id":"52992fc2","ts":...}` and no reference to `.coding-hermes/evidence/GAP-003-load-audit.md`, which the row's acceptance string requires to exist and contain a before/after measurement.

findings.detection: completion event records no measurement while the task's acceptance explicitly requires one recorded in the completion event
findings.detail: The matching events.jsonl row (id 450) carries `"detail":"{\"status\":\"complete\"}"` with no spawn-count/wall-clock/peak-children measurement, contradicting acceptance item (3) "prove before/after with a concrete measurement ... recorded in the completion event".

findings.detection: field type changed from string to object for an existing schema field
findings.detail: GAP-003's `detail` was a JSON string in the removed line and is now an object `{"evidence":[...],"text":"..."}`, while every other row in tasks.jsonl keeps `detail` as a string — consumers that parse `detail` as text will break on this row.

findings.detection: completion recorded with ci_result=SKIP while acceptance requires the full suite green after the change
findings.detail: The row sets `"ci_result":"SKIP"` and the foreman_note says "CI pending this push", so the acceptance arm `npx vitest run must exit 0 after the change` is not evidenced by CI at completion time.

findings.detection: generated timestamp uses a doubled Z suffix (`...ZZ`)
findings.detail: `"generated": "2026-11-17T16:36:10.867ZZ"` keeps the pre-existing malformed `ZZ` suffix rather than a valid ISO-8601 timestamp, so the regenerated index still emits an unparseable date.

review.summary: The board rows close GAP-003 as complete without the evidence file or measurement its own acceptance demands, and the regenerated index carries a malformed timestamp.
